items.prompt: Why is route-then-immediately-cancel not equivalent to rejecting an excessive order before routing?

options.text: Every cancellation is guaranteed faster than execution
The source event log becomes irrelevant
The cancel request reverses all past fills
Execution can occur before cancellation is confirmed
options.why: Prevention and later mitigation are different.

items.explanation: The SEC staff FAQ specifically rejects chase-and-cancel as the pre-entry prevention described there.
